statistics: mean of per-reference-CpG m/(C+m+h); unique read/reference/CpG observations
replication_rule: same 10kb reference anchor in >=3 individuals each supported by >=3 distinct window widths at main CpG thresholds, >=5 read IDs and no edge flags; metadata-majority windows excluded; descriptive, not significance
partial_windows: clipped to the 200 kb flank plotting domain and explicitly flagged
input_call_filters: unchanged from inputs/new_config.json; plot missingness overrides missing_plot in that archived file
model_sensitivity: exclude model_metadata containing modbase_model_version_id only for separate sensitivity; does not recalibrate calls
